A wholly underwhelming experience.
Jul 2026 • Solo
I've given this place 2 stars because the food wasn't terrible, but it was a long way from good. It markets itself as "Japanese fine dining," and while the location is undeniably impressive, with beautiful views over the sea from above the hotel, that's about where the "fine" dining experience ends.

The food was bland and tasted like it had been prepared by someone who had learned Japanese cuisine from a cookbook rather than through real hands-on experience. People often say photos don't do a restaurant justice; in this case, the photos don't quite capture just how underwhelming the food actually was. The only standout dishes were the Unagi Chawanmushi and the mochi dessert (which I suspect was store-bought).

The sashimi salad was short on sashimi and heavy on an overly sweet dressing that masked a mix of leafy vegetables of varying freshness. Overall, the dishes lacked balance, finesse and the attention to detail you'd expect from a restaurant positioning itself as Japanese fine dining.

Overall, this felt like a restaurant trading on its location and presentation rather than the quality and authenticity of its food. I left wishing the kitchen had lived up to the spectacular setting.

Exceptional Cuisine, Service, and Atmosphere
Jul 2026 • Couples
An exceptional dining experience from start to finish. The restaurant offers a beautiful and elegant atmosphere, creating the perfect setting for a memorable evening.

The food was simply outstanding – without a doubt some of the best Japanese cuisine we have ever had. Every dish was expertly prepared, beautifully presented, and full of authentic flavors.

The service was equally impressive. The staff were attentive, professional, and genuinely welcoming, making us feel valued throughout the evening.

If you are looking for a truly special Japanese dining experience, this restaurant is a must-visit. We will definitely be returning.
